scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -k -n "backend,web" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: node init && bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.dev:backend: node init && bun run --cwd backend dev
scripts.build: node init && bun run --cwd web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
